title: Deploying Incidetective on Coolify fails
description: First deployment of Incidetective on the homelab's Coolify (which already runs another app, a dashboard). Coolify marks the deployment as failed and the app's address returns HTTP 503.

groundTruth.cause: The web container publishes host port 8080, which another app on the same Coolify server (the Night City dashboard) already uses, so Docker could not start it: "Bind for 0.0.0.0:8080 failed: port is already allocated". Postgres and the API started fine; the leading "Error:" lines are Docker Compose's normal progress output on stderr.
goodNextSteps: Find what already uses port 8080 on the server (docker ps, ss -ltnp or lsof) and give this app a different host port
Remove the host port mapping, since Coolify's proxy reaches the container without one

notes: Real incident: the author's homelab Coolify (4.7.6), 25 November 2026. The full deployment log as exported from Coolify (739 lines: git clone, image builds, [DEBUG] commands), with the failure at the end. Fixed by setting WEB_PORT=8090. Checked for secrets: build-arg names only, no values. The cause is stated in one line, so this checks that Coolify and Docker Compose output is read well, including the misleading "Error:" prefix Coolify puts on Compose's progress lines. The copy-from-UI layout (timestamp on its own line) is covered by a parser test instead.
setupNotes: Homelab server 10.0.0.210 running Coolify 4.7.6 with its Traefik proxy. It already hosts other apps, including the Night City dashboard. Incidetective is being added as a Docker Compose app built from GitHub.
